QUOTE: Tool-only pattern (`filesystem.*`, `git.commit`): the part before `:` is matched against the fully qualified tool name. With no colon, every call to that tool matches, whatever its arguments.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shared `fnmatch` matcher, splitting at `:` into a tool part and an argument part, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
